system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Asset freeze legitimacy presumption",
    "detail": "Presenting frozen foreign assets as inherently belonging to the sanctioned nation with right of return, framing sanctions as temporary impediments rather than legal enforcement actions.",
    "debias": "Clarify that frozen assets are held due to legal sanctions imposed for specific violations, not merely administrative delays.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Iran wants the US to release its frozen assets as part of talks. The money could help it rebuild its battered economy.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/15/what-are-irans-100bn-in-frozen-assets-and-where-are-they-held?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Iran is requesting the US lift sanctions that froze approximately $100 billion in assets, which were frozen due to violations of international agreements and could potentially aid Iran's economy if released as part of negotiations."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Distraction accusation during crisis",
    "detail": "Alleging that media attention to one crisis enables or distracts from another simultaneous crisis, implying deliberate manipulation of focus.",
    "debias": "Report concurrent events separately without implying causal connection between news coverage and policy actions.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "As world focuses on Iran, Israel 'engineering starvation policy' in Gaza",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/4/15/as-world-focuses-on-iran-israel-engineering-starvation-policy-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "While international attention remains on US-Iran negotiations, humanitarian organizations report severe food and fuel shortages in Gaza amid ongoing restrictions."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Negotiator character delegitimization",
    "detail": "Highlighting personal background or political views of diplomatic negotiators to cast doubt on their ability to negotiate fairly.",
    "debias": "Report negotiator identities factually without suggesting their backgrounds disqualify them from diplomatic roles.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israel's ambassador held talks with his Lebanese counterpart. But critics say Yechiel Leiter is a problematic negotiator",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/4/15/what-you-need-to-know-about-israels-ambassador-to-the-us?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Israel's ambassador Yechiel Leiter held talks with his Lebanese counterpart. Some observers have raised questions about his settler background and its potential impact on negotiations."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Vulnerability equivalence erasure framing",
    "detail": "Framing legal migration status as conferring similar vulnerability to trafficking as illegal status, erasing distinctions between legal protections and illegal exploitation.",
    "debias": "Distinguish between legal migration with inadequate protections and trafficking of undocumented persons, noting different policy solutions.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Debt, employer control and temporary visa rules can leave migrant workers trapped.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2026/4/16/legal-migrants-remain-vulnerable-to-trafficking?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Some legal migrant workers face debt bondage and employer control due to temporary visa restrictions that limit their ability to change employers."
  }
]
